notes: Transfer of customers between salesmen: header per salesman and date, one line per customer; saving a line moves the customer's balance with a debit / credit transfer pair (AR_MAINTRNS / AR_SUBTRNS) and gives the department to the new salesman; deleting the last transfer reverses it; button 'إنزال عملاء المندوب' (APP_RULES3_AR).

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or FROM_SLSMAN in (select SALESMAN_CODE from AR_SALESMAN_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

info.name: SLSM
info.sql: select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(name_e, name_a), name_a)) from salesman where code = to_number(:PAGE_FROM_SLSMAN)

info.name: CNT
info.sql: select count(*) from ar_slsman_trnsfr_det where from_slsman = to_number(:PAGE_FROM_SLSMAN) and trnsfr_date = to_date(:PAGE_TRNSFR_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') and date_serial = to_number(:PAGE_DATE_SERIAL)

actions.name: LOAD_CUSTOMERS
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد نقل كل عملاء المندوب (أو عملاء القسم المختار) إلى المندوب المختار؟
actions.confirm_e: Transfer all customers of the salesman (or of the chosen department) to the chosen salesman?

params.name: CTGRY_CODE
params.lov_sql: select cs.ctgry_code || ' - ' || ct.category_type_desca d, cs.ctgry_code r from ar_ctgry_salesman cs, st_category_type ct where ct.category_type_code = cs.ctgry_code and cs.salesman_code = to_number(:PAGE_FROM_SLSMAN) order by 2

params.name: TO_SLSMAN
params.lov_sql: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from salesman where code <> nvl(to_number(:PAGE_FROM_SLSMAN), -1) order by code

params.name: CR_TRNS_CODE
params.lov_sql: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = 1 and trns_type = 5 order by id

params.name: DB_TRNS_CODE
params.lov_sql: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = 0 and trns_type = 5 order by id
